shots.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: final interactive homepage background for a children's illustrated book, landscape 1536 x 1024. The attached image is a STYLE AND HOUSE-ARCHITECTURE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Create a new beautifully composed empty room view inside the SAME Mr. PinPin hedgehog family cottage. Match the warm high-end animated-feature storybook rendering of the reference: soft inviting modeled forms, honey-colored rounded timber, cream plaster walls, tactile but stylized wood, golden morning sunlight, cozy braided rug, quiet magical forest atmosphere. Camera: seated child's eye height, gently wide 38mm equivalent lens, facing the corner between the cottage front wall and its reading-nook side wall. Two unmistakable clickable destinations, both fully visible with clear silhouettes: at the LEFT third, the familiar arched green plank front door with a single brass knob, set in a rounded honey-oak frame. Door is opened outward far enough to reveal a luminous forest path and flowers outside; physically credible door geometry, one leaf only, no obstructing furniture. At the RIGHT third, a beautiful substantial built-in honey-oak BOOKCASE with softly rounded rectangular top and three clearly separated broad shelves holding some colorful story magazines and a few closed books. Bookcase extends approximately x=900..1390,y=210..845 in the image, door opening/frame approximately x=210..620,y=175..835. Leave a generous uncluttered carpeted floor between them so the two choices read immediately. A small round cottage window may appear near the door; if present, use exactly eight straight radial wooden spokes around a small clear-glazed circular center. Gentle sunlight through door and window lights the room, no harsh dark corners. Include a little warm domestic character through a small plant on the windowsill and a folded cushion near the rug, but don't obscure either interactive object. Keep the upper central plaster wall quiet for a small HTML title added later. Keep all important objects within the central safe area with breathing room. No people, no animals, no characters, no text, no letters, no labels, no interface boxes, no glowing outlines, no segmentation colors, no watermark. The real interface will add contours. Full polished painting, coherent architecture, no photorealistic PBR product rendering.

shots.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: final responsive chapter-library background plate. Reference attached is the approved Mr. PinPin home menu, used for matching its RIGHT-HAND honey-oak bookcase, not an exact edit target. Move the camera up close and straight in front of that SAME rounded-corner oak bookcase. Generate a perfectly frontal, nearly orthographic view in landscape 1536x1024. The cabinet occupies x=65..1470,y=35..990, with very gently rounded rectangular top corners, substantial warm wooden outer frame, softly lit honey-wood back panel and THREE EMPTY BROAD SHELF COMPARTMENTS. The top compartment is y=95..325, middle y=365..635, bottom y=675..925, with three thick level wooden ledges whose top surfaces are approximately y=325,635,925. Keep all shelf horizontal edges straight and level across the image, no vertical dividers. The THREE shelf rows are COMPLETELY EMPTY: remove all books, magazines, jars, plants, miniatures, ornaments and clutter inside the cabinet. These wide empty spaces are intentional places for the real published magazine covers to be overlaid later in HTML; do not draw fake books or blank rectangles. The cabinet is framed by a narrow glimpse of cream plaster wall at both sides and a little warm wood floor below, matching the house. Warm diffuse golden morning illumination comes from offscreen LEFT and gently fills the cabinet interiors; wood backdrop moderately darker than bright illustrated book covers would be, but no black holes, harsh shine or deep distracting shadows. Match the reference's soft warm polished animated-feature children's storybook art, rounded timber, handcrafted joinery and understated texture. Readable medium-scale shapes, not photorealistic PBR. Subtle depth behind each shelf and a narrow visible wooden ledge on which magazines can visually stand. No people, animals, characters, text, lettering, logos, labels, frames for UI, placeholders, gold UI outline, or watermark. A functional beautiful empty wooden magazine shelf background, consistent geometry and lighting with the room.
